sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: After one of your own direct damage events deals positive resolved bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage to a creature, you may apply Armor Crusher once that turn. NEW: any actual creature defense qualifies, including natural armor and unarmored defense; the feat does not require a removable suit. The triggering event finishes against its original AC. Apply a separate −1 AC layer through your next original regular start. Further applications from any owner never sum below −1; retain independent expiry records, so the penalty persists while at least one remains. Fully prevented damage does not trigger; temp-HP absorption of a positive resolved packet still does. Copied, reflected, transferred and ongoing periodic damage do not generate applications. Do not damage or regrade armor.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Creature-wide scope, direct-event eligibility, single identity family across owners, and expiry arbitration.
submittedWorkedCases: An AC17 creature takes 4 piercing damage: the triggering attack used17; later attacks use16 until expiry.
Two owners apply the feat: AC falls only1. The later record can keep that same −1 after the first expires.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Action, once per short rest: choose one to three other willing allied creatures within30ft who can hear and understand the brief directive. Lock recipients and their order, spend the use, then resolve each sequentially. Each may spend its own available Reaction immediately for a separate floor(current relevant Speed/2)-ft movement-cost budget. Recheck hearing, willingness, position and capability at that recipient's resolution. Terrain and hazards apply; movement from this instruction provokes no opportunity attacks. Speed0 gives no movement. Declining or losing eligibility grants no replacement recipient and does not refund the commander; a recipient that does not move need not spend a Reaction. No ordinary movement/Action/BA resource is restored.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Bonus Action, once per short rest: enter this distinct feat rage through your second future original regular-start marker; outside initiative12elapsed seconds. Each qualifying weapon attack hit during it adds one base weapon damage die, doubled as part of a critical. Melee and ranged weapon attacks qualify because the current effect says weapon attacks; unarmed attacks do not, and natural attacks require an actual weapon profile. Apply its −2 AC continuously. Repeated same identity cannot stack; independently active Aggressive stance's −2 AC also applies. NEW the rage ends early if you become Incapacitated. This is a rage for Frenzied Rage's operating trigger, but acquiring this feat alone does not satisfy Frenzied Rage's separately printed Berserker-feat-or-class-rage prerequisite. It supplies no +2 rage damage to replace and no resistance or spell ban.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: When your actual melee weapon attack critically hits a living non-bloodless creature, after the hit resolves apply feat.bleeding-edge in family.bleeding, stack group feat.bleeding-edge:<owner>. NEW physical type is slashing. It deals1d4 at each of the next three future target regular starts, then ends; applying during a start never adds an immediate tick. Same-owner reapplication refreshes three remaining ticks without adding a second instance; different owners retain competing groups under the existing highest-expected-damage/earliest-application arbitration. Losing due groups still spend ticks. Snapshot the ending Medicine DC10+your PB at application. Victim or adjacent helper may spend an Action with one usable hand and access to the injury, selecting this record before WIS Medicine; success ends that record only. No kit charge is required by this feat. Retain generic positive-potential magical-healing automatic cure for this ordinary Bleeding record. Critical dice do not double later periodic damage; no resource/attack procs from ticks. No positive-damage prerequisite is added beyond actual hit and bleedable body.

submittedWorkedCases: At PB3, an adjacent Medicine total13 ends one selected owner's record; another owner's independent record remains.
A concurrent stronger Bleed wins two due starts. Bleeding Edge still uses those two ticks and has only one left.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: If you have undergone no actual positional displacement since your most recent original regular-turn start, spend Reaction when a direct damage event would damage you. NEW all voluntary, forced, carried and teleport displacement counts, even returning to the same square; standing, turning in place and a failed move do not. Before your first encounter turn, count displacement since encounter entry. Reduce one whole resolved incoming event by max(0,PB+CON modifier), after ordinary passive defenses and before temporary HP. Allocate reduction across components in their stable order, never below0; one attack's fire and slashing are one event, separate attacks are not. Do not re-mitigate a transferred packet that explicitly forbids recipient mitigation. This affects damage only, not attached conditions, sacrificed HP or state assignment. Paying with a zero reduction is allowed but does not create healing.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Once per turn during your own legal voluntary movement, declare crossing one hostile creature's occupied space whose size is no more than one category larger. You must have enough ordinary remaining movement cost and a visible or known legal unoccupied exit to traverse its entire occupied footprint; occupied terrain costs at least difficult. Before first entry, that creature may spend its Reaction for one legal melee opportunity attack against you, even though you are entering rather than leaving. All actual reaction, sight, reach and opportunity-immunity restrictions apply. If it hits, this passage fails: remain in your last legal outside space, spend the first attempted entry step's cost and the feat use. The hit's other consequences resolve normally. If it misses, declines, cannot attack or its opportunity attack is suppressed, proceed, paying actual traversal costs. Recheck the exit after interruptions; if traversal becomes impossible before entry, stay outside and spend the committed use. Do not willingly start a traversal without a complete legal route. Other creatures may make normal opportunity attacks. This does not shove or phase through a creature.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Your ranged attacks ignore disadvantage caused specifically by a seeing, non-Incapacitated hostile creature within5ft of you. This covers ranged weapon and ranged spell attacks. It does not remove long-range, unseen-target, Prone, restrained or other independent disadvantage. If any other disadvantage remains, apply ordinary cancellation. Making that ranged attack does not itself provoke an opportunity attack from any source that explicitly uses making the ranged attack as its trigger; it does not suppress a separate spellcasting, movement or other legal trigger. Current generic combat creates no opportunity attack just for making a ranged attack; do not add such a penalty for other characters.

If a target cannot perceive the act, it is ineligible rather than automatically beaten.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: When you legally take Dash, activate Overrun for that turn's subsequent ordinary movement; Dash supplies its normal increased cap, not a second separate movement grant. You may attempt passage through actual creatures at most one size larger, allied or hostile. NEW each distinct creature may be challenged once that turn, with no duplicate attempt from extra Dashes. Before entering its first occupied space, it makes STR save DC8+PB+your STR; a willing ally may elect failure as this feat's explicit exception. On failure push it5ft to a legal adjacent side destination you choose that clears the necessary passage. Success, anchoring, or no legal clearing destination blocks this special passage; remain outside and spend the attempted first entry step's ordinary cost. Do not start without enough budget for a complete legal path/end. The feat does not suppress opportunity attacks. A creature already passable under ordinary size rules can instead be crossed normally without invoking the feature. It grants no Prone, damage or ability to remain in occupied space.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Track a consecutive direct melee-attack hit chain for each owner during one encounter. Every actual melee attack you make advances the event sequence: a hit on the same current target increases the count; a miss or attack directed at a different target ends the old chain, and a hit on the new target starts a new count1. NEW any intervening nonmelee attack also breaks the chain; movement, spellcasting without attacks and nonattack actions do not. Own/off-turn melee attacks participate, but copies/periodic events do not. Once per turn, before rolling a qualifying hit's damage, add min(PB, prior consecutive hits on that target) as a flat native-type bonus. Only declare when at least one prior hit exists; spending on this hit prevents spending on a later hit that turn. The chain persists across regular turn boundaries but ends on target death/removal, encounter conclusion, or loss of that actual creature identity. Transformation of the same surviving identity retains it if target continuity is real.

Measure actual occupied bodies on the current map; a large creature needs opposite sides of its whole footprint, not merely two nearby squares. Both participants must perceive the target and be able to attack it; total cover or unusable reach prevents flanking. This geometry itself grants no universal advantage. One successful attack may receive only one Tactical Flanker die across all owners; choose its funding owner before rolling. A critical doubles this attack rider die. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Bonus Action, once per short rest: while holding an actual usable ranged weapon, choose a creature you can see within that weapon's printed maximum legal long range (normal range if no long value) and with line of effect. NEW a thrown weapon with an actual range also qualifies. Record the chosen weapon only to establish activation range; stowing it later does not end the mark. For1minute, the first attack against the marked creature by each other creature currently allied to you gains+1 to hit. This is once per ally identity for the entire mark, not per turn, and is consumed by that attack even if it misses. You are not your own ally for this feat. A creature's later alliance change does not reset its used identity; a newly arriving genuine ally can use its own first attack. Only one mark per owner; replacement, owner death or expiry ends the old record. NEW owner incapacitation does not end an existing mark. No continuous range/tether after activation and no vision/targeting permission is granted. Multiple marks never give more than+1 to the same attack; all applicable unspent first-attack entitlements for that attacker consume on that first event.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Activation range, no self, whole-mark identity budget, overlap consumption and ending.
submittedWorkedCases: An ally misses its first attack and later hits in round2. Only the miss received the mark's+1.
Two commanders mark the same target. An ally's first attack gains+1, not+2, and consumes that ally's first-attack entitlement in both marks.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Whenever your own direct legal effect pushes or knocks a creature a positive specified distance away from you or along its printed outward direction, increase that displacement by5ft. It can modify a weapon, ordinary maneuver, spell or class effect if you are the actual source; not a companion's own effect, pull, teleport, fall, current, carried movement or copy/transfer. Preserve its original size/eligibility/path. Add the5 once per displacement event; same-family copies do not add further5. The final movement still stops at walls, anchors and illegal positions. Once per turn, if that same displacement-producing effect has an actual STR/DEX/other save which the target fails by5 or more, also apply Prone independently of blocked displacement. No save is invented for an ordinary opposed Shove; its numerical contest difference is not a save failure margin. Automatic failure has no numerical margin unless its source explicitly says otherwise. If an original effect already applies Prone, do not duplicate it.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW full completion: Action, once per short rest, wield a loaded/properly supplied bow using arrows and choose a visible point within that bow's actual normal range and line of effect. Select up to PB distinct perceived creatures in a10ft-radius area around that point, each independently in normal range and with a legal shot. You may exclude allies; no hidden-target scan or compulsory friendly fire is added. Lock targets/order, spend the use and one actual arrow per selected target, then make one separate normal ranged weapon attack against each. Apply actual AC, cover, proficiency, crits and ordinary native bow damage to each; there is no area save/DC or shared damage roll. Extra Attack does not multiply this special Action. Each target at most once; newly entering creatures cannot replace lost targets. A target becoming illegal before its shot is skipped and its committed arrow remains spent. Interrupted remaining shots lose the use and committed ammunition. Loading/reload and all other item restrictions remain, so a weapon that cannot fire the necessary arrows cannot declare that many shots. It is a special Volley Action, not Attack Action for Double Tap or Eldritch Combat.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: With actual Whip proficiency, wielding a usable whip, replace one attack of your Attack Action with one control attempt against a creature within the whip's actual melee reach. Choose disarm or trip before the roll. NEW make one weapon check d20+the whip's actual attack ability modifier+PB against the target's chosen STR Athletics orDEX Acrobatics total; opposed ties preserve state. This deals no damage, cannot crit, and is not a hit for on-hit riders. Trip requires target no more than one size larger and on success applies Prone subject to immunity/support. Disarm requires one actual reachable held object; on success choose a legal adjacent unoccupied drop space, otherwise the target's space, respecting real non-droppable bonds. No rest cap, but each attempt spends one actual Attack Action attack. Whip reach does not create a grapple or long-term restraint. Lunge modifies one melee weapon attack, not this check, so does not extend the control reach.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW complete interpretation: surrounded means at least two different conscious hostile creatures within5ft of you, on opposite sides under Tactical Flanker's center-segment geometry, each currently able to attack you in melee. While that predicate holds, gain+1AC as an explicit conversion of the source's undefined+5% evasion; this is not literal5%damage reduction or a separate avoidance roll. Once on your own turn, after your melee weapon attack hits a creature while surrounded, you may deal a cleave packet to one different perceived hostile creature within the actual reach of that same weapon. Amount is floor10% of that hit's eligible native weapon damage before percentages/defenses; allocate native types as shared arithmetic. No second attack roll, no new critical and no on-hit riders/resources from this derived packet; ordinary recipient defenses apply. The primary attack can be fully mitigated and still supply its legal pre-defense native amount, but a missed attack cannot. Cleave needs real reach/line, deals0 if the rounded amount is0, and cannot itself cleave or trigger a drop-generated attack/heal. Losing surrounded geometry ends AC immediately.

One surrounding enemy becomes Incapacitated. The+1AC ends immediately; a later hit cannot use this feat's cleave until the predicate returns.

No normal casting cost is waived. An attack hit does not substitute for a spell's own required attack/save. Longer spells, BA spells and Reaction spells are not compressed by this grant. Separately, once per SR after your melee weapon attack hits, you may append one legitimately available Action-time Touch spell of any legally accessible rank to that same sole target without an extra Action; this can occur off-turn. NEW both modes share at most one embedded cast per actual regular creature turn and cannot be combined on the same hit/Action. Spend SR use at casting commitment, even if countered. These appended castings do not provoke opportunity attacks solely for casting/performing the appended attack-spell operation, but movement has ordinary triggers. Neither casting may create a further Eldritch append from attacks in its own causal root. Actual source-specific secondary/resource restrictions remain; no prestige class is acquired.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Acquire with CON15 and the actual Berserker feat or an actual class feature expressly granting a rage state. No name-only qualification from Berserker Brew, Mooncursed, a prestige lineage or a damage buff. While in an actual acquired Berserker rage, replace its+2 melee bonus with+3 on melee weapon attacks; for any other qualifying rage lacking that+2, NEW grant+3flat melee-weapon damage as this feat's own family, without replacing separately rolled dice. Do not add+3 on top of the same Berserker+2. Berserker Rage CF-03 is an operating rage once this feat was legally acquired by its printed prerequisite, but not an acquisition substitute. Once per turn after your melee attack reduces an independent meaningful hostile from positiveHP to0, choose EITHER one immediate additional melee attack (NEW only on your own turn) OR extend that same currently active rage's time endpoint by one original6second round. Extra attack requires real reach/target/weapon/capability and creates no Action/BA; shared causal limits prevent drop-trigger attack chains. NEW at most three time extensions per single rage use; non-time endings such as incapacitation or missing upkeep remain. Once per rage, on your turn spend BA to charge along a declared straight legal route with a separate current walking-Speed movement-cost budget, through at most three hostile creatures no more than one size larger. Recheck a complete legal unoccupied endpoint before starting, pay occupied-space difficult cost and normal hazards/opportunity attacks. Each crossed creature once makesCON save DC8+PB+STR; failure applies Dazed until its next future original regular end. No damage/Prone/push is implied. If the route is interrupted, stop in the last legal space; already crossed targets remain affected and use stays spent. It cannot force passage when there is no legal complete crossing route.
